{{Top|leg}}
'''Artificial perspirators''' were microscopic devices that were implanted into the epidermal layers of the skin. They would simulate the action of natural sweat glands, and were often used following [[Reconstructive surgery/Legends|major reconstructive plastic surgery]]. In addition, they would rid the body of toxins by thermally siphoning the body's fluids through microcapillary ducts.<ref name="A Guide to the Star Wars Universe">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> The surgeon who operated on [[Grammel]] informed him that artificial perspirators were not necessary in his case, which included the replacement of his right forearm.<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>
